paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 3.16, with a change of -6.92% compared to the prior close and -36.16% over a window of 22 sessions. There have been 8 new news items in the last 24 hours, including an amendment to the terms of an equipment supply loan from MUFG Bank and the issuance of a draft environmental impact statement by the Nuclear Regulatory Commission for Fermi America's Matador units.

Recent news headlines also include a price target reduction from Cantor Fitzgerald, a strategic partnership with Advanced Micro Devices, and a preliminary recommendation from the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission supporting a combined license for four planned Westinghouse AP1000 reactors. Additionally, a major shareholder sold 1,297,200 shares of stock at an average price of 3.15.

There have been various SEC filings, including a Limited Waiver and Amendment No. 1 to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement, insider transaction reports, and notices of proposed sales. The company has also posted a fact sheet containing additional information regarding its lease with TensorWave at the Project Matador site to its website.
